title: Assam invokes NSA against Kaziranga activist after bail
summary: Pranab Doley, a Kaziranga activist, was granted bail on December 10. The next day, Assam invoked the National Security Act (NSA) against him. The government claimed that Doley's actions posed a threat to national security. The opposition alleged that the move was an attempt to silence dissent. Police claimed that they had received threats from Doley's supporters. The NSA has been invoked 12 times in Assam since its implementation in 2015.
